entries.topic: Owner requests analysis and proposal for an Agent SKU update tab, instant password-confirmed manual sync, rich local status, minimal provider usage
facts: Owner requests a new Windows Agent tab named Cập nhật SKU showing three daily automatic windows, actual DONE/failure, SKU and coarse LTA/SHELViNG/UNKNOWN information, and a password-confirmed Cập nhật ngay button. Owner requests a low/near-zero incremental provider-usage design and a proposal before implementation.

Verified main after D167 PR559 and PR564: Agent v126 D167SkuCoordinator owns event-triggered one-shot timer and Schedule(day); Agent D167SkuServiceClient parses only slot, state and scheduled_at_ms, while InventoryCore ensureSchedule SELECT already returns complete_at and receipt_json, and status exposes receipt totals. Agent Program.cs currently only adds Tổng quan and Cài đặt top-level pages. Existing VerifyCurrentAgentPasswordForAction supports normal local verifier and privileged server OTP/emergency proof. Firebase operator/PRIMARY HA and InventoryCore lease are authoritative for SKU writes.

Current InventoryCore rejects all non-DONE slot POSTs before scheduled_at_ms and prevents rerunning DONE; manual click requires a new explicit server-authorized idempotent manual run contract, NOT merely calling Queue or resetting a DONE slot. Keep daily verified FULL prerequisite, three scheduled slots, HA fenced generation/CAS, source/WMS read-only and Confirm latency guard.

Recommended read UX uses only cached Schedule GET response, existing Agent HA/WMS events and local result snapshot; no new idle poll/timer, Firebase listener/document, per-PDA or per-SKU sync. Extend already-selected response parsing and the same authoritative DONE receipt to show source rows, created/updated/activated/hidden/unchanged, completed_at, source unchanged and source/actor. Add coarse area counts during already-performed workbook parse or publish and distinguish WMS observation vs authoritative live catalog. Detailed SKU list from bounded local last-verified workbook only, marked STALE after restart/failover; only explicit user-driven on-demand server page query if Owner specifically requires restart-persistent remote catalog access.

Proposed manual default: when no validated same-day FULL, run one validated FULL; if today's FULL exists, run DELTA. Same-day manual FULL must satisfy the daily gate and not duplicate morning slot; subsequent manual DELTA must be a distinct run ID and must not silently mark 12/19 DONE or suppress scheduled runs. Server enforces current authenticated eligible Agent, PRIMARY generation, WMS readiness, serial exclusion for Confirm, atomic preview/conflicts, password reauthentication and deduplication. Display proper skipped noon coalescence and system/API/permission error types. No passwords, WMS headers or raw dataset in logs.

Usage options reviewed: status quo log-only => zero new usage but poor discoverability; client-only presentation => almost zero provider usage but no true instant manual run; recommended event-fed client view + fenced on-demand manual job => zero extra recurring reads when idle and only bounded WMS export/Worker-Gateway/SQL/HA operations per manual click. Baseline source staging uploads 500 SKU/request, i.e. 5 chunks/2500 and 10 chunks/5000, with fingerprint fast path when identical; these are code-path estimates, not measured billable savings.
alternatives: O0 no change, logs only: no new spend; fails Owner UX and manual action.
O1 Agent-only UI with local trigger of existing scheduled Queue: low additional read cost but cannot bypass server time and DONE gate; REJECT.

O2 recommended: tab local-first + reuse existing schedule/receipt + new fenced manual FULL/DELTA job contract only when clicked, with security and audited receipts; defer any persistent detailed catalog remote query until need is demonstrated.
open_questions: Approval needed to code O2 and final UX details. Recommended default: manual FULL if daily FULL not yet valid, otherwise DELTA; a forced complete FULL REPLACE after daily FULL requires a separate privileged confirmation, not implicit default.

Whether a successful manual update inside the 12:00-12:15/19:00-19:15 scheduled window may satisfy its scheduled DELTA slot, or all three scheduled observations must still execute independently; recommendation is do not silently consume a slot.
Whether user wants a full searchable 5000-row SKU table after Agent restarts; recommended last snapshot only with clear stale/unknown indicator and explicit read-on-demand if essential.
